long.title: How to Unclog a Toilet Fast (With or Without a Plunger)
long.description:
A clogged toilet is usually a 10-minute fix. In this video you'll learn the 7 steps to unclog a toilet yourself: stop the water, protect the floor, seal the drain with a flange plunger, plunge in rhythm, use dish soap and hot water, break the clog with a toilet auger, then test the flush. Plus what to try when nothing works, the 4 signs that mean you should call a plumber, how to keep it from clogging again, and the 4 mistakes to avoid.
